REMAP-CAP: the DSA template no document states

Each REMAP-CAP domain-specific appendix (DSA) follows a common structure, but no REMAP-CAP document gives that structure as a template. Here it is read from the headings of the nine DSAs read in this work: 581 headings under 191 distinct titles. The heading-level counterpart of finding RC-1 (components every DSA states).

IAV's headings 14.1, 14.1.1, 14.2, 14.2.1, 14.2.2 belong to its Japan region-specific modification, which sits inside the DSA (RC-18). 3 of their titles also occur at IAV 8.x, so they show as a second number in IAV's cells and the counts per title do not change.

Titles matched exactly: lower case, characters other than a–z ignored; no fuzzy matching and no domain names masked, so "Corticosteroid Domain Governance" and "Antibiotic Domain Governance" stay apart. A cell holds the section number(s) of that heading in that DSA; a dashed cell: the DSA has no heading with that title. Rows ordered by the mean relative position of the heading's first occurrence in each DSA. Number of DSAs per title: 9 DSAs: 36; 8 DSAs: 6; 7 DSAs: 5; 6 DSAs: 1; 4 DSAs: 1; 3 DSAs: 2; 2 DSAs: 12; one DSA only: 128. Headings and numbers as each document's table of contents gives them (headings.csv, written by 12_headings.py); documents on the REMAP-CAP page.
